svg.text: Same commands scored by both releases; counts are commands where only one of the two was right.
Triage Score: every risky command asked about or blocked earns a point; the score shrinks in proportion when more than 10% of safe commands are stopped.
Weighted: Bench 2 core (lancet-bench-2-next) 58%, ShellRisk-Bench test 20%, neutral set (Rogue + shell-safety-v2 test) 21%. Each release scored once at its shipped setting.
lancet-bench-2-next replaced the retired lancet-bench-1 as the Triage benchmark; no LANCET release was trained, tuned or calibrated on it.
